Pac Resource Delete Pac
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/pacFiles/:pacId

Deletes an existing PAC file including all of its versions based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
pacId
int32
REQUIRED

Specifies the ID of the PAC file

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
